subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK unconditionally reject request bodies above 16 MiB and bodies not completed within 30 seconds, or should those limits be revised from an established SDK request contract before merge?
rationale: The resource bound is desirable and the implementation is sound, but repository evidence does not define the maximum legitimate Copilot BYOK request size or duration, so accepting the new failure boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Calibrate the limits
options.body: Confirm the supported Copilot SDK request envelope, revise the constants if necessary, and cover the largest legitimate request plus overflow boundaries before merge.

options.title: Approve the proposed contract
options.body: Explicitly accept 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the Copilot BYOK compatibility boundary and merge the current implementation.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave the proxy behavior unchanged until a defensible request-size and duration contract can be established.

recommendation.title: Calibrate the limits
recommendation.body: Confirm the supported Copilot SDK request envelope, revise the constants if necessary, and cover the largest legitimate request plus overflow boundaries before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared guard infrastructure and were explicitly routed into this PR's discussion, so they are the strongest available owner for confirming the cross-ingress limit policy.
